blockers.detail: Ubuntu candidate has no armel interpreter/runtime. Vendor armel apps cannot execute in candidate unchanged.

Stock libcrypt has private libc symbol requirements absent in tested new armel reference. Rebuild libxcrypt compatibility package; preserve stock export versions, test actual relocation and crypt vectors.
Exclude host-architecture anomaly from target runtime and development packages; never relabel it armel.
Static baseline contains DT_NEEDED without same-ABI provider; classify optional/dead payloads and repair any deployed runtime closures.
Keep exact vendor-private libraries together in ABI-qualified directories. Matching SONAME alone does not prove API/structure compatibility; plugin and global lookup scopes require measured tests.

limitations: Successful mapping/relocation cannot establish hardware IOCTL, shared-memory layout, NVRAM, WiFi, AiMesh, web, RGB or AI-board control correctness.
No executable from BE98 is accepted as a drop-in BE19000AI runtime by this report.
Current vendor32 blobs retain their binary time32 ABI; new component time64 defaults must use verified explicit boundary conversions.
A complete dynamic runtime search audit also needs NSS, OpenSSL providers, dlopen plugins and actual invocation environment.

method.providers: All ELF SONAME and filename aliases indexed per ABI. Own RPATH/RUNPATH then explicit model default directories; inherited RPATH, cwd-relative paths and ld.so.cache not evaluated. Byte-identical paths are duplicates, not distinct provider payloads. Selection is a conservative model, not a claim of real rtld resolution.
method.symbols: Versioned non-weak imports checked by exact symbol name/version; closure-wide unversioned strong names checked conservatively. Does not simulate rtld relocation/IFUNC/COPY/RTLD_LOCAL semantics.
method.symlinks: Root-relative component-by-component resolution, absolute targets remain inside inspected root.

non_elf_control_scripts.compatibility_risk: Uses [ "$value" == "literal" ] under #!/bin/sh. Vendor BusyBox ash accepts ==; Ubuntu dash requires POSIX =. Do not run upgrade script as a probe; preserve behavior with scoped source correction and test inert fixture.
non_elf_control_scripts.required_runtime: /ai mount and NVRAM/service broker must exist; script intentionally initiates AI-board firmware update and deletes firmware file after completion.

scope: BCM only. Static ELF and archive reads; no target program, constructor, service, router operation or vendor-tree mutation.
status: static audit complete; dynamic loader and ASUS hardware/service acceptance remain separate gates

new_glibc_comparison.note: BE98 library is diagnostic reference only, not copied or accepted for BE19000AI.
